common.restart_note: Changing the language takes effect the next time you start the app.
welcome.title: Welcome to Meeting Recorder
welcome.subtitle: Two quick choices to get you going. You can change everything later in Settings.
welcome.model.base.name: Fast
welcome.model.small.name: Balanced
welcome.model.small.desc: A little slower, a bit more accurate
welcome.model.turbo.name: Most accurate
welcome.model.turbo.desc: Best quality, slower on a CPU
welcome.backend.claude.name: Claude Code
welcome.backend.claude.desc: Uses your existing Claude login; no API key needed.
welcome.backend.anthropic.name: Anthropic API
welcome.backend.openai.name: ChatGPT (OpenAI)
welcome.backend.ollama.name: Local model (Ollama)
welcome.backend.ollama.desc: Runs fully offline on your machine.
welcome.backend.none.name: None
welcome.note.anthropic: Enter a key, or leave it blank to use the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable.
welcome.note.openai: Enter a key, or leave it blank to use the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable.
welcome.note.ollama.up: Ollama is running. Summaries stay fully offline.
welcome.note.ollama.down: Ollama not detected. Install it from ollama.com, start it, then pull a model (e.g. ollama pull llama3.1).
welcome.note.claude.ready: Ready. Summaries use your Claude login.
welcome.note.claude.missing: The Claude CLI ('claude') isn't installed. Install it or pick another option; you'll still get transcripts either way.
welcome.note.none: No summaries will be written. You still get full transcripts.
settings.title: Settings - Meeting Recorder
settings.transcription.model.hint: large-v3-turbo: best accuracy for the speed; tiny/base: fastest
settings.transcription.language.hint: Set it if auto-detection guesses wrong (e.g. mixed-language meetings)
settings.transcription.device.hint: auto / cuda use an NVIDIA GPU if available, otherwise the CPU
settings.transcription.live_mode.hint: Draft transcript (+ optional notes) while recording; off = only at stop. The clean transcript is still produced at stop.
settings.transcription.live_model.hint: Fast model for the live draft, e.g. base or tiny
settings.transcription.live_notes_interv: seconds (only in the auto-notes live mode)
settings.transcription.live_catchup: Catch up on earlier audio when I turn Live on mid-meeting
settings.transcription.live_catchup.hint: Also transcribes the already-recorded part in the background, so notes cover the whole meeting. CPU-heavy on long meetings.
settings.audio.mic.hint: Or type part of a device name
settings.audio.system.hint: What the other participants say: your speakers/headset
settings.audio.system.hint.macos: macOS: pick a virtual device such as BlackHole (see the README)
settings.audio.threshold.hint: 0-1; quieter audio counts as silence and isn't transcribed
settings.summaries.anthropic_key.hint: Only for anthropic-api. The ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable is better: settings.json is plain text.
settings.summaries.openai_key.hint: Only for openai-api. The OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable is better: settings.json is plain text.
settings.summaries.hint.claude: e.g. sonnet or opus; empty = the CLI's default
settings.summaries.hint.ollama: required, e.g. llama3.1 (run: ollama pull llama3.1)
settings.behavior.hotkey.hint: Starts/stops recording from anywhere, e.g. ctrl+alt+r. Empty = off.
settings.behavior.meeting_prompt: Offer to record when a call starts
settings.behavior.meeting_prompt.hint: Asks when one of these apps starts using the microphone - never records by itself
settings.behavior.meeting_apps.hint: Comma-separated parts of app names; * = any app
settings.behavior.tray: Show an icon in the notification area
settings.behavior.min_tray: Minimizing hides the window to the tray
settings.error.timeout: Auto-stop must be a number of seconds (0 = never).
settings.error.threshold: Silence level must be a number between 0 and 1.
settings.error.ollama_url: Ollama URL must start with http:// or https://
settings.error.live_interval: Live update interval must be at least 2 seconds.
settings.error.live_notes_interval: Auto-notes interval must be at least 60 seconds.
app.live.placeholder: The live transcript will appear here as you talk, once you start recording.
app.live.hint.off: Nothing live. The transcript and summary are created when you press Stop.
app.live.hint.transcript: A rough transcript appears below, live, as you talk. The clean transcript + summary are still made at Stop.
app.live.hint.transcript_notes: Live transcript below, plus a button to write running notes (key points, decisions, actions) whenever you want.
app.live.hint.auto_notes: Live transcript below, with running notes that rewrite themselves automatically every few minutes.
app.msg.no_backend:
No transcription backend found.

Install one with:  pip install faster-whisper
app.msg.no_audio: Audio capture is unavailable: the 'soundcard' package could not be loaded.
app.quit.title: Quit Meeting Recorder?
app.quit.body:
Currently {what}.

Recordings are saved to disk as you go, so nothing is lost - you can finish unprocessed files later with 'Process pending'.

Quit now?
app.tray.minimized: Still running here. Click the icon to show the window.
app.prompt.started.title: {app} is using the microphone
app.prompt.started.body: Record this meeting? Remember to ask everyone for their consent first.
app.prompt.ended.title: {app} stopped using the microphone
app.prompt.ended.body: The call seems to have ended. Stop recording?
